query: SELECT (SELECT a.acknowledgement_id FROM stand_down_acknowledgements a JOIN record_identities r ON r.kind = 'standDownAcknowledgement' AND r.id = a.acknowledgement_id WHERE a.assignment_id = CAST(json_extract(k.value, '$[0]') AS TEXT) AND a.through_epoch = CAST(json_extract(k.value, '$[1]') AS INTEGER) AND json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.envelope.actor.actor.identity.kind') = 'session' AND json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.envelope.actor.actor.identity.session.endpoint.serviceId') = ? AND json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.envelope.actor.actor.identity.session.endpoint.endpointId') = ? AND json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.envelope.actor.actor.identity.session.sessionId') = ? ORDER BY a.through_position DESC, a.acknowledgement_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "id: String" FROM json_each(?) k
